spans.s:
औलूक n. (-कं) A flock of owls.
 E. उलूक, and अण् aff.

औलूक्य m. (-क्यः) A follower of the Vaiseshika doctrine.
 E. उलूक an
owl, and ष्यञ् affix, like an owl: this etymology, and perhaps the
word, owes its origin probably to controversial animosity.

औलूखल mfn. (-लः-ली-लं) Ground or pounded in a mortar.
 E. उलूखल, and
अण् aff.
